info.name: opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me
info.description:
# OpenGeo Cambodia API - Postman Collection

Postman collection for the **OpenGeo Cambodia API**, an open REST API for Cambodia's geography data.

- **Administrative hierarchy:** 25 provinces, 210 districts, 1,661 communes and 14,576 villages from the Ministry of Economy and Finance Open Data Portal (data.mef.gov.kh).
- **Boundaries:** province, district and commune polygons as GeoJSON or lightweight summaries.
- **Geocoding:** reverse and forward geocoding via OpenStreetMap Nominatim, normalised to the Cambodian hierarchy.
- **Free and open:** no API keys. Only GET requests.

### Rate limits (per IP)
- `/api/admin/*` and `/api/boundaries/*`: 10,000 requests/min
- `/api/admin/search`: 120 requests/min
- `/api/geocode/*`: 30 requests/min
- Other `/api/*`: 5,000 requests/min

### Variables
- `{{baseUrl}}`: defaults to `https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me`. Use `http://localhost:3000` for local development.
- `{{provinceId}}`, `{{districtId}}`, `{{communeId}}`, `{{villageId}}`: numeric ids for the Administrative endpoints (12 / 1201 / 120101 / 12010101).
- `{{provinceCode}}`, `{{districtCode}}`, `{{communeCode}}`: zero-padded codes for the Boundaries endpoints (12 / 1201 / 120101).
- `{{searchQuery}}`, `{{geocodeQuery}}`: sample search text.
- `{{latitude}}`, `{{longitude}}`: sample coordinates for reverse geocoding (11.5564, 104.9282).

Every request has a test script checking for 200 and the expected body shape.

item.name: Administrative
item.description:
The four-tier hierarchy as flat JSON records, without geometry. These are the endpoints for forms, address validation and lookups.

All responses use the `{ success, data, meta? }` envelope. Ids are numeric (e.g. 12 / 1201 / 120101 / 12010101).

**Rate limits:** 10,000 requests/min per IP for `/api/admin/*`, except `/api/admin/search` which is limited to 120 requests/min per IP.

item.name: Boundaries
item.description:
Polygons for provinces, districts and communes. List endpoints return GeoJSON by default (`application/geo+json`). Add `format=summary` to get lightweight JSON with centroids and bounding boxes but no coordinates. Boundary endpoints take the zero-padded code (e.g. `070203`), not the numeric id; PCODEs such as `KH12` are also accepted.

**Rate limit:** 10,000 requests/min per IP.

item.name: Geocoding
item.description:
Address lookups backed by OpenStreetMap Nominatim, normalised into Cambodia's hierarchy and cached for a week.

**Rate limit:** 30 requests/min per IP (respects OSM usage policy).

item.name: System
item.description:
Service metadata, health and machine-readable documentation. These responses do not use the `{ success, data }` envelope.

**Rate limit:** `/api/info` falls under the general API limit of 5,000 requests/min per IP.
